product: Barro's AI Pizza Designer for Pizza Connection 3 - Pizza Creator

truth_policy.rule: Only an observed command result with retained evidence may be PASS. Source presence, inference, or a mockup never proves runtime behavior.
truth_policy.promotion: All release_required gates must PASS before the project may be described as runtime-certified.

gates.requirement: Required source, assets, installer, and contract files exist
All backend unit tests pass
Catalog contains exactly 87 unique game ingredient IDs in six categories
All four reference images match their locked hashes

layers.name: Exact assembly build
layers.runs_on: build host with supplied game DLLs

gates.requirement: Both proprietary game assemblies match the locked target hashes
Plugin compiles with zero errors against the exact supplied game and Unity assemblies
Prebuilt plugin hash and build provenance agree
Windows compiler parity build succeeds against the installed game DLLs
BepInEx 5 x64 initializes under the target Unity player
The Barro's plugin is discovered and Awake completes without a relevant exception
A fifth tab is registered and remains inside the stock side rail
BARRO'S PIZZA CREATOR header aspect-fits the title strip without covering the close button
The stock Bakehouse header returns on stock tabs
The compact two-row Chat actions and Pizza Art Studio controls remain inside the fitted panel without covering native tabs
Preview places a validated recipe through IPizzaCreatorService.LoadPizzaFromModel
Restore returns to the captured pre-preview PizzaModel
Apply commits the selected validated recipe
Save invokes the native recipe-book operation
A saved AI recipe reloads with name, shape, placements, and profit factor intact

layers.name: Microphone and speech
layers.runs_on: Windows game runtime with configured STT

gates.requirement: At least one Windows microphone device is enumerated and capture returns non-empty PCM
The configured speech provider returns a non-empty transcript used as a recipe prompt
When optional Azure agent speech is configured and unmuted, one focused design-agent reply returns WAV audio and plays through Unity
gates.automation: runtime event plus operator audio confirmation

gates.requirement: Live Chat screenshot captured and compared with 01_chat.png
Live Lab screenshot captured and compared with 02_lab.png
Live Crew screenshot captured and compared with 03_crew.png
Live Voice screenshot captured and compared with 04_voice.png

layers.name: Precision pizza artwork
layers.runs_on: portable tests and Windows game runtime

gates.requirement: All seven built-in templates and custom provider pixel maps compile to valid catalog ingredients with no more than 180 exact placements
A high-detail artwork preview loads through IPizzaCreatorService with retained runtime evidence and a recognizable ingredient picture
Draft, Standard and High visibly change real placement counts while Remix remains deterministic by seed
gates.automation: portable tests plus guided runtime comparison

layers.name: Barro's media deck

gates.requirement: Barro's music replaces stock Pizza Creator music by default and the Stock button reversibly restores the original soundtrack
Media playback observes a real started state before advancing and releases the previous decoded clip so playback cannot rapidly cycle or accumulate tracks
gates.automation: portable source contract plus ten-minute runtime soak

gates.automation: portable import tests plus guided runtime import

gates.requirement: The custom Media panel consumes pointer events so its controls cannot activate hidden stock controls underneath
gates.automation: portable source contract plus guided runtime clicks

gates.automation: portable contract checks plus guided save/reload comparison

gates.requirement: Bundled and imported OGG output is audio-only 48 kHz stereo Vorbis q8, fully decode-valid, timestamp-repaired, loudness-targeted and true-peak protected with retained conversion hashes
gates.automation: FFmpeg stream/decode/loudness audit plus import report

gates.requirement: When configured agent voice begins, any active Barro's or Stock soundtrack pauses one second before speech and resumes only after speech finishes if it had been playing
